description: Use this first to find ChileCompra public tenders matching a need. Pass Spanish keywords for best results (e.g. 'firewall', 'notebook', 'ciberseguridad'). Returns only tenders still open for bids (set include_closed=true for history), ordered by match score and then the soonest closing date, each with tender_id, retrieved_at and source_url. Andes adds the synonyms Chilean buyers use (e.g. 'ciberseguridad' also finds 'seguridad informática', 'firewall', 'SOC'): audit.expanded_terms lists them and each result's matched_terms says which term hit. One concept per word is best; accents do not matter. audit.index_last_synced_at and audit.index_open_tenders describe the whole index: zero results with a recent sync means nothing open matches today. Call get_tender_detail before deciding anything. Access: open to anonymous agents (rate-limited); a free AndesPass key raises the limit.
name: search_tenders
title: Search public tenders
